name: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group Company Limited
summary: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group Company Limited, established in Langfang, China, in 2007, is a provider of essential digital infrastructure. The company specializes in delivering server hosting services to both major internet companies and large cloud vendors across China. In addition to core hosting, it offers extensive managed services, which include operation, maintenance, and security management, as well as other enhanced support. Furthermore, the company provides advanced intelligent computing services specifically tailored for clients developing large-scale artificial intelligence models. It adopted its current name in September 2022, having previously been known as Range Technology Development Co., Ltd.
